(5) Ibn Abi'l-Hadid Mu'tazali in his Shahre Nahju'l-Balagha, Volume I, page 134, quoting from Jauhari's
Kitab al-Saqifa, writes in detail about the affair of the Saqifa al-Bani Sa'ad.

"The Bani Hashim and ‘Ali
were assembled in ‘Ali's house.

Zubair was also with them since he considered himself one of the Bani
Hashim.
‘Ali used to say, 'Zubair was always with us until his sons were grown up.
‘Umar went to Fatima's house with a group of men.

Usayd and Salma were
also with him.
‘Umar asked them to come out and swear allegiance.

Zubair drew his
sword and came out.
